name: Power-factor meter
summary: A power-factor meter indicates the relationship between real and apparent power according to the instrument's measurement method.
description: A power-factor meter indicates the relationship between real and apparent power according to the instrument's measurement method. Its voltage and current inputs need phase-consistent connections.
readingNotes: Identify the instrument's sign convention and whether it reports displacement or total power factor.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: Power factor is a ratio; it is not reactive power in kvar.
